annotations.title: Look up the technologies a site's home page shows (site builder, shop, analytics, payments, hosting, agent files)

description: Which technologies does a site's public home page show? Send a domain; we make one https GET of its home page and read the response headers and page source with our own written rules. You get a list of technologies with a category (site builder or CMS, shop platform, analytics, tag manager, payments, framework, hosting or CDN, web server, engagement tools, agent-readable files such as llms.txt or MCP links the page points to), a confidence for each, and a signed, dated observation you can keep as proof of what was seen. Free, no sign-up, 100 lookups a day per caller. Statements are about what the page showed, not what runs behind it. One domain per call (no lists), one fetch, no crawling, no results stored (short-lived rate counters only). This tool exists for agents that find it through MCP registries; it is reached through the LLPRO gateway (MCP, A2A and REST).

domain.description: One bare domain name such as example.com. No scheme, path, port or list.
